STEP 5. Check the harness wire between auto-cruise 
control vacuum pump connector A-01 and auto-cruise 
control-ECU connector C-20.
Q: Is any harness wire between auto-cruise control 
vacuum pump connector A-01 and auto-cruise control-
ECU connector C-20 damaged?
YES : Repair the harness wire and then check that 
diagnostic trouble code 11 is not output.
NO : Check that diagnostic trouble code 11 is not output. 
If diagnostic trouble code 11 is output, replace the 
auto-cruise control-ECU. (Refer to P.17-81.)
 Then check that diagnostic trouble code 11 is not 
output.
